args.code:
# Reverse the XOR algorithm
# The check is: (input[i] XOR running_sum) == encoded[i]
# So: input[i] = encoded[i] XOR running_sum
# running_sum starts at 0x2d (45), and after each iteration adds input[i]

encoded = bytes([0x6b, 0x3f, 0xfe, 0x47, 0x3c, 0xad, 0x5f, 0xe6, 
                 0x60, 0xcf, 0x88, 0x24, 0xa9, 0x47, 0xfe, 0x74, 
                 0x11, 0x86, 0x0f, 0x59, 0x93, 0xe3, 0x6e])

result = []
running_sum = 0x2d  # edx = 0x2d initially

for i in range(23):
    # input[i] = encoded[i] XOR running_sum
    char = encoded[i] ^ (running_sum & 0xff)  # XOR is done on byte level
    result.append(char)
    running_sum = (running_sum + char) & 0xffffffff  # add edx, ecx (lower 32 bits)

print("Decoded password:", bytes(result))
print("ASCII:", ''.join(chr(c) if 32 <= c < 127 else f'\\x{c:02x}' for c in result))
